faqs.question: Why is SMO important for my business?
faqs.answer: SMO is crucial because it allows you to connect with your audience, build brand loyalty, and drive organic traffic to your website. By optimizing your social media presence, you can effectively promote your products or services, engage with customers, and gain valuable insights to improve your overall marketing strategy.

faqs.question: How can SMO help in increasing website traffic?
faqs.answer: SMO drives website traffic by creating and sharing compelling content that encourages users to click through to your website. By engaging with your audience on social media, sharing blog posts, promoting special offers, and optimizing profile bio links, we create multiple pathways that funnel social followers directly to your website.

faqs.question: How long does it take to see SMO results?
faqs.answer: Meaningful follower growth and engagement improvements are typically visible within 60–90 days of consistent SMO. Significant brand awareness and lead generation results generally show by month 4–6, depending on your industry, competition level, and starting point.

faqs.question: Which social media platforms do you manage?
faqs.answer: We manage all major platforms — Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter/X, and Pinterest. We recommend the best platform mix for your business based on your target audience, industry, and business goals.

faqs.question: Do you create the content or do we need to provide it?
faqs.answer: We handle everything in-house — our creative team designs graphics, writes captions, scripts reels, and creates all content. You simply review and approve before publishing. You can optionally provide raw photos or videos that we incorporate into the content.
